title: Final Farewell
subtitle: What is the price one must pay for freedom, my dear?

trails.title: Regular Procurement
trails.description: It's because of these necessities that we can never truly call the sea our home.

content.text:
...

- Meat, Vegetables, Fruits
  As always √

- Tobacco, Alcohol
  As always √

...

- Ice Cream
  As always √ 
  Under orders of the new captain, all pending deliveries have been canceled.

...

- Ornamental Plants and Animals
  Got plenty more from Australia √

...

- First Aid Kits, Medications
  As always √

- Lifeboat Maintenance
  Maintenance complete, backup boats are empty √
  New captain orders maintenance for the backup boats as well.

items.text: The joy of this declaration has reached the hearts of the crowd.
Amid the cheers, more and more masks are cast aside.

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: You never cease to amaze me, do you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Manus Vindictae have failed.

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: It would appear that way to you, wouldn't it, Ms. Vertin?

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: How shall I congratulate you?
A Manus messenger emerges behind Grace.

items.speaker: Manus Messenger
items.text: Ma'am, we've arrived at the target location.

items.speaker: Manus Messenger
items.text: We've gathered all the remaining shells and are ready to activate the teleportation ritual at any time.

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: Well, well. Time does fly, as they say. Be seeing you and sooner than you think!
Grace opens her pocket watch one last time before casually tossing it aside.

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: But before I go, consider this a parting gift from your captain, for old time's sake.
*boom*
An explosion booms from the ship's depths.
Grace gives an elegant bow.

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: Goodbye, my dear guests. From the bottom of my heart—

items.speaker: Ms. Grace
items.text: Thank you all for this unforgettable journey.
*rumble*

items.speaker: Helmsman Charlie
items.text: That came from the engine room!

items.speaker: Helmsman Charlie
items.text: Those tin-headed bastards, they must have done something to it.

items.speaker: Helmsman Esam
items.text: Go see what you can from the deck, Charlie!
The seasoned helmsmen hurriedly make their way to the deck.

items.speaker: Helmsman Charlie
items.text: Damn it all! They've blown a hole straight through the starboard hull!
While the helmsmen pace anxiously, Barcarola suddenly realizes the gravity of the situation.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Gentlemen, you can't possibly be saying that the "Free Breeze" is going to sink?!
The ship's tremors again. It's as if they're on a battlefield.

items.speaker: Helmsman Esam
items.text: What's worse, that explosion came from over by the lifeboats!

items.speaker: Helmsman Esam
items.text: These bastards are hellbent on making sure we all end up at the bottom of the sea!
The sound of tearing waves, humming steel plates, and crying guests pours into the cabin through shattered portholes.
The pitch-black sea stretches as far as the eye can see, its surface alive with turbulent, inky swirls.
There is another wave of panic as the ship tilts once again.

items.speaker: Guest I
items.text: Help us, Ms. Barcarola! You promised to keep us safe!

items.speaker: Guest II
items.text: And you, Miss!

items.speaker: Guest II
items.text: Aren't you from the Foundation or whatever?! You said you'd protect us!
The guests are desperately clinging to any chance of salvation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Please line up, everyone. My suitcase should be able to temporarily shelter some passengers.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Barcarola, do you know how many passengers are aboard?
The musician clearly knows every detail about the "Free Breeze."

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: About 1600 in total. But I think many of them will be injured. I don't know how well they can move.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My suitcase alone won't be able to transfer that many people in time.
Suddenly, the communicator clutched in Sonetto's hand makes a sharp sound.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: Beep beep! Beep beep!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The signal's back, Timekeeper!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Just as we suspected, they were jamming our signal.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But how did they know our internal frequency?
She quickly brushes this question aside. There are more urgent matters to attend to.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is Vertin. Please come in.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're currently aboard the cruise ship "Free Breeze," at coordinates 55.35°S, 65.01°W.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The engine has been destroyed by Manus Vindictae, and the ship is taking on water fast.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There are more than 1600 passengers aboard. But we won't be able to evacuate every passenger through my suitcase alone before the ship goes under.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We're in need of immediate rescue.

items.speaker: Communicator
items.text: Understood. We will dispatch rescue resources and personnel from the nearest branch as soon as possible. Before their arrival, please do everything possible to minimize casualties.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ms. Barcarola, could you point me towards the radio room? I believe our friends may be in need of help.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Of course.
Sonetto jogs away in the pointed direction.
The creaking of the ship's planks grows louder, and its railings and rigging groan painfully. Their sound carries on the freezing wind, and whips at the ears of the crowd.
Shivering from the cold, Barcarola remembers something.

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Wait. Ms. Grace wasn't the captain for long. It's possible she didn't know about the ship's backup lifeboats. They might still be intact.

items.speaker: Helmsman Esam
items.text: Good thinking, Ms. Barcarola!

items.speaker: Helmsman Charlie
items.text: You're a natural-born captain!

items.speaker: Barcarola
items.text: Everyone, follow me!
